objective: How does loadConfig load configuration in config.ts?
description: Searches a repository for occurrences of a symbol by exact identifier match and literal text match, deduplicates by file:line, and returns up to limit {file, line, text} candidates. Scope: syntactic search only, no semantic resolution. Limits: capped by limit (default 3); text may be empty.

outputContract.returns: { file: string; line: number; text: string; }[]
